Name: 24H Clock
Author: ampedPF
Description:
Tested with Stardew Valley 1.6.15  
This content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] allows you to display the clock and time references in 24H format and converts measurement references to the metric system.  
[url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI]SMAPI[/url] is mandatory.  
You must select the additional language "ENGLISH 24H" using the arrow on the right of the language menu.  
Check out the mod's settings ingame with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].  
The Stardew Valley sign in the intro can be changed in the mod menu.
Check the preview in the media section.
Restart the game after you've made any changes.

Downloads.Description: Needs SMAPI 4.5.2 or later & Content Patcher 2.9.1 or later
